title: Rational sections of an invertible module on a smooth curve and their divisors
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, $C$ a smooth connected curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves] with generic point $\eta$ and function field $k(C)=\mathcal O_{C,\eta}$ [def-sc-function-field] (a field, $C$ being integral by [lem-sc-smooth-connected-curve-local-rings]), and $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_C$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Put $\mathcal L\otimes_{\mathcal O_C}k(C):=\mathcal L_\eta$, the stalk of $\mathcal L$ at $\eta$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], a one-dimensional $k(C)$-vector space by [lem-sc-invertible-module-generic-stalk]. A *rational section* of $\mathcal L$ is an element $s\in\mathcal L_\eta$; it is *nonzero* if $s\neq0$. For a nonzero rational section $s$ and a closed point $P$ of $C$, choose a generator $e_P$ of the free rank-one $\mathcal O_{C,P}$-module $\mathcal L_P$ and let $g_P\in k(C)^*$ be the element with $s=g_P\,\lambda_P(e_P)$, where $\lambda_P:\mathcal L_P\to\mathcal L_\eta$ is the germ map; the *order of $s$ at $P$* is $\operatorname{ord}_P(s):=v_P(g_P)$, with $v_P$ the normalized valuation of the discrete valuation ring $\mathcal O_{C,P}$ [lem-sc-smooth-connected-curve-local-rings]. It does not depend on the choice of $e_P$, and $\operatorname{ord}_P(s)\neq0$ for only finitely many $P$ [lem-sc-rational-section-order]. The *divisor of $s$* is
$$\operatorname{div}(s)=\operatorname{div}_{\mathcal L}(s):=\sum_P\operatorname{ord}_P(s)\,[P]\in\operatorname{Div}(C)$$
[def-sc-divisor]. For $\mathcal L=\mathcal O_C$, $e_P=1$, it is the principal divisor $\operatorname{div}(s)$ of $s\in k(C)^*$ of [def-sc-divisor].

source.place: Tag 02SF (divisors-definition-order-vanishing-meromorphic): $\operatorname{ord}_{Z,\mathcal L}(s)=\operatorname{ord}_{\mathcal O_{X,\xi}}(s/s_\xi)$ with $s_\xi$ a generator of $\mathcal L_\xi$; Tag 0BE6 (divisors-definition-divisor-invertible-sheaf), part (1): $\operatorname{div}_{\mathcal L}(s)=\sum\operatorname{ord}_{Z,\mathcal L}(s)[Z]$; meromorphic sections on an integral scheme are the elements of $\mathcal L_\eta$ by Tag 01X5 (divisors-lemma-meromorphic-functions-integral-scheme) (2). Specialized to a smooth connected curve over an algebraically closed field, where the prime divisors are the closed points and $\operatorname{ord}_{\mathcal O_{C,P}}=v_P$ (Tag 02MD, the local ring being a discrete valuation ring).
